verdict.rationale: Trello's own marketing claims it can 'Automate tasks and workflows' (trello-docs-3), which is a first-party automation capability. Nothing describes how automations are built, whether they need no code, or whether they can chain multiple steps. The board-button and Power-Up material comes from developer docs and is a building block for coders, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of a no-code rule/automation builder, evidence of multi-step triggers and actions, first-party detail on automation configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
